extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Humana plan available in Lee County has a $30 monthly premium, a $95 drug deductible and a $3100 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed the required steps by delivering the disclaimer before discussing plan benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The call included a discussion of plan details and required the customer to provide personal information.
composition.coaching_note: Marcus did well in delivering the disclaimer and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. However, he should avoid asking for personal information like Medicare numbers and dates of birth during the initial call to maintain privacy and comply with regulations.
